patterns.description: Scroll-triggered reveals for major content blocks. Motion sequences narrative: headlines enter first, then media surfaces, then CTAs, then supporting copy. Uses GSAP transform-only reveals (no opacity:0 in from()) to keep content visible in screenshots.
motionOrder: major media surface or product demo
patterns.gsapPattern: gsap.from(el, { y: 40, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power2.out', scrollTrigger: { trigger: el, start: 'top 85%' } })

buttonTransitions.description: Outline/ghost CTA transitions to solid fill on hover.
buttonTransitions.transition: background-color 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)

opacityLinkInteraction.description: Nav links and icon links use opacity: 0.6 on hover rather than color change.

gsapRules.safeInitialState: transform-only — use y/x/scale only. NEVER opacity:0 in from(). Opacity:0 hides content before ScrollTrigger fires, causing blank sections on load and during screenshots.
gsapRules.safeExample: gsap.from(el, { y: 40, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power2.out', scrollTrigger: { trigger: el, start: 'top 85%' } })
gsapRules.unsafeExample: gsap.from(el, { opacity: 0, y: 40 }) — DO NOT USE

recommendations: Use transform and opacity for scroll-reveal animations to enable hardware acceleration
Apply will-change: transform on sticky scroll panels during scroll phase only, remove after
